body.condition: Foldwise, \(\|\widehat E_{-k}[\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k)}\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k)\top}]-E[D^0_{J_n}D_{J_n}^{0\top}]\|_{\mathrm{op}}=O_p(\eta_{G,n})\) and \(\|\widehat E_{-k}[\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k)}\sum_{a=0}^1t_aS_a(\widehat h_{a0}^{(-k)},\widehat q_{a0}^{(-k)})]-E[D^0_{J_n}\sum_{a=0}^1t_aS_a(h^0_{a0},q^0_{a0})]\|_2=O_p(\eta_{c,n})\), where \((\eta_{G,n}+\eta_{c,n})/\kappa_{J_n}=o(1)\).
